subject: a small guest bedroom upstairs in a fantasy medieval inn
scene: Camera at standing eye level in the middle of a modest wooden guest room under a sloping beamed ceiling. A low bed with heavy woollen blankets and a carved headboard, a small writing desk with a candle and a quill, a wooden chest, a washstand with a ceramic bowl and jug, a leaded lattice window with warm evening light and a view of rooftops, a woven rug on wide floorboards, cloaks on wall pegs.
